title: Pvt Ltd vs LLP vs OPC
subtitle: Which business structure should you choose?
tagline: Ownership, compliance and funding compared – a simple guide for Indian founders

cards.heading: Private Limited (Pvt Ltd)
bullets: Liability limited to the shares you hold
Can issue shares to investors and ESOPs to staff
Highest compliance: statutory audit every year

cards.heading: LLP
bullets: Lower compliance: audit only above ₹40 lakh turnover or ₹25 lakh contribution

cards.heading: One Person Company (OPC)
bullets: Convert to Pvt Ltd when you add co-founders or investors

rows.heading: How to choose – ask these questions in order

steps.title: Raising investors soon?
steps.text: Yes → Pvt Ltd. Investors need shares.

steps.title: Starting alone?
steps.text: Yes → OPC, and convert later if you grow.

steps.title: Partners in a service or professional firm?
Want the lowest yearly compliance?
steps.text: LLP is usually the lightest of the three.

steps.title: Still unsure?
steps.text: Talk to a CS/CA before you register – changing later costs time and money.

cards.heading: Compliance at a glance
table: Only above ₹40 lakh turnover or ₹25 lakh contribution

cards.heading: Important points
bullets: All three give limited liability – your personal assets are protected
Late ROC filings cost ₹100 per day per form, with no upper limit
Pick the structure for where you want to be in 3 years, not just today
